title: “The teachers are confused as well”: A Multiple-Stakeholder Ethics Discussion on Large Language Models in Computing Education

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of semi-structured stakeholder interviews focusing on users' perceptions of LLMs imposing Western-centric views.

Qualitative evaluation through stakeholder interviews discussing educational experiences with LLMs generating gendered language and occupational stereotypes (e.g., stereotypes about what a computer programmer looks like).

Thematic analysis of interviews regarding users' general concerns over LLMs producing offensive stereotypes in code generation (e.g., variable names) and biased outputs in high-stakes critical applications like hiring and social security benefits.
